info.name: DAturUpanandinIwippaRI
info.value: prAyeRAyamANapUrvaka eva prayujyate . ' aByAsaH = pAramparyeRa vfttiH ' iti kzIrasvAmI .

examples: 'haviSSezAn saMplomnAya piRqAnkftvA' (Apa0 SrO0 8.4.16.6). samplomnAya=sampramfdya. ralayoraviSezaH. nalopaSCAndasaH.
'tvAmAmananti prakftiM puruzArTapravartinIm' (ku0 2.13). Amananti udAharanti, nigacCanti, nigamayanti.
'evaM hi sUtrakArA Amananti' (mAlatI0 7). Amananti upadeSaM paramparIRaM saMsmaranti, pUrvAnukAntamanuSAsati.
'samO hi SizwErAmnAtO vartsyantAvAmayaH sa (SatruH) ca' (SiSu0 2.10). samO tulyO kaTitO varDizyamARo rogaH SatruSca.
'Amananmantramuttamam' (Bawwi0 17.30). Amanan kaRWe kurvan, aDIyAno vA, AvfttyA paWanniti vA.
'treyaRApi nivartante sidDyA pratizeDena pratyAmnAyena' (BA0 SrO0 6.15.6). pratyAmnAyaH pratyAdeSaH, Adizwasya punarAdeSena nivartanam.

'yadyanAQyo'gnInAdaDIta kAmamevEkAM gAM dadyAtsA gavAM pratyAmnAyo Bavati' (Apa0 SrO0 5.6.20.18). gavAM pratyAmnAyo bahvInAM gavAM dAnasya nivartikA Bavati. na raTAdInanyajAtIyAnnivartayatIti BAzyam. gavAM pratyAmnAya iti vacanAdanyat sarvaM dAtavyamiti rudradattaH.
